scope: One orderly guest kernel reboot on the same writable disk; automatic lingering user-manager timer retries only the unfinished native Dagu finalizer under the existing run ID.
scheduler: systemd user native-reboot.timer: OnStartupSec=2s, OnUnitInactiveSec=15s, explicit loginctl enable-linger; native-reboot.service invokes supported Dagu CLI execution
frozen_before_trial: guest Python executable and version before native start
acceptance: Preboot native run is running; finalizer has published its wait marker and no completed effect exists.
Durable checkpoint and exclusive execution claim both record execution count one; original oracle passes all 12 tests.
Guest kernel boot ID changes; machine ID, filesystem UUID, disk token, QEMU process and host disk inode remain the same.
Read-only boot observer emits completed recovery on serial while the user manager is active and linger is enabled, before any post-reboot SSH connection.
Native Dagu selected-step retry uses the original run ID and reports succeeded; checkpoint and exclusive claim bytes remain unchanged.
Original final 12-test oracle passes and exactly one exclusive completed.json effect exists.
Input hashes remain unchanged; before/after native histories, full task logs and journals remain available in the artifact.
Guest QEMU process is retired and its private SSH key is removed in finally cleanup.
